description: Source code for utility functions in the ANGLE shader translator, including float parsing, type mapping, and qualifier checks.

methods.name: atoi_clamp
methods.description: Converts string to unsigned int with clamp to max value if conversion fails.

methods.name: NumericLexFloat32OutOfRangeToInfinity
methods.description: Parses a decimal string into float, converting out-of-range values to infinity.

methods.name: strtof_clamp
methods.description: Parses string to float with clamping for out-of-range values.

methods.name: GLVariableType
methods.description: Maps TType to corresponding OpenGL enum type.

methods.name: GLVariablePrecision
methods.description: Returns the precision qualifier for a given type.

methods.name: ArrayString
methods.description: Returns string representation of array sizes.

methods.name: GetTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name string for a given TType.

methods.name: IsVaryingOut
methods.description: Checks if qualifier is a varying output.

methods.name: IsVaryingIn
methods.description: Checks if qualifier is a varying input.

methods.name: IsVarying
methods.description: Checks if qualifier is either varying in or out.

methods.name: IsGeometryShaderInput
methods.description: Determines if qualifier is valid for geometry shader input.

methods.name: GetInterpolationType
methods.description: Returns interpolation type based on qualifier.

methods.name: GetShaderVariableBasicType
methods.description: Maps ShaderVariable to TType.

methods.name: DeclareGlobalVariable
methods.description: Declares a global variable in the shader AST.

methods.name: CanBeInvariantESSL1
methods.description: Checks if qualifier can be invariant in ESSL 1.0.

methods.name: CanBeInvariantESSL3OrGreater
methods.description: Checks if qualifier can be invariant in ESSL 3.0+.

methods.name: IsBuiltinOutputVariable
methods.description: Checks if qualifier is a built-in output variable.

methods.name: IsBuiltinFragmentInputVariable
methods.description: Checks if qualifier is a built-in fragment input variable.

methods.name: IsShaderOutput
methods.description: Checks if qualifier is a shader output.

methods.name: IsOutputESSL
methods.description: Checks if shader output is ESSL.

methods.name: IsOutputGLSL
methods.description: Checks if shader output is GLSL.

methods.name: IsOutputHLSL
methods.description: Checks if shader output is HLSL.

methods.name: IsOutputVulkan
methods.description: Checks if shader output is Vulkan.

methods.name: IsOutputMetal
methods.description: Checks if shader output is Metal.

methods.name: IsInShaderStorageBlock
methods.description: Determines if node is in shader storage block.

methods.name: GetImageInternalFormatType
methods.description: Maps internal format enum to GL enum.

methods.name: IsSpecWithFunctionBodyNewScope
methods.description: Checks if shader spec and version require new scope.

methods.name: GetConversion
methods.description: Determines implicit type conversion between basic types.

methods.name: IsValidImplicitConversion
methods.description: Checks if a conversion is valid for a given operator.
